d: The Adani Group has denied allegations that it reduced the estimated cost of its Tarali pumped storage project in Maharashtra to lower its wildlife conservation obligations. The company says the Rs 56.75-crore figure cited in a clearance proposal was only for preliminary surveys, while the full project cost remains Rs 5,675 crore. This follows Chandan Haygunde 's investigation in The Indian Express into the sharp revision and its impact on the contribution to the Sahyadri Tiger Reserve.
